title: Sign in with demo credentials
description: This test verifies that a visitor can log in with the demo account and reach the authenticated app state.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Verify the authenticated app state is visible

title: Open order history after direct access while signed out
description: This verifies that an unauthenticated visitor who tries to open the protected order history page is redirected to the login page.

steps.description: Navigate to /orders
Verify the login page is displayed

title: Prevent unauthenticated access to admin page
description: This verifies that a signed-out visitor who tries to open the protected admin page is redirected to sign in.

steps.description: Navigate to /admin
Verify the login page is displayed

title: Browse the product catalog
description: This test verifies that a visitor can open the catalog and see product cards with images, categories, and prices.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Verify product cards are displayed
Verify product images, categories, and prices are displayed

title: Log in and view protected order history
description: This verifies that a signed-in user can open the protected order history page and review previously recorded orders.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Click the link to the order history page
Verify prior order cards are displayed
Verify order date and price information are displayed

title: Log out and lose access to protected routes
description: This verifies that a signed-in user can log out from the top navigation and is then redirected back to the login page when attempting to revisit a protected route.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Click the logout control in the top navigation
Click the link to the order history page
Verify the login page is displayed
Verify protected content is not displayed

title: Open a product from the catalog
description: This test verifies that a visitor can open a product details page from the catalog and view the selected product information.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click a product card's details link
Verify the product details view is displayed
Verify the product description and price are displayed

title: View a product's full details
description: This test verifies that a visitor can open a specific product page and read its details.

steps.description: Navigate to /product/1
Verify the product details view is displayed
Verify the product description and price are displayed

title: Open order history after authenticating from a protected route
description: This verifies that a user who is redirected to sign in from the protected order history route can authenticate and then access the page successfully.

steps.description: Navigate to /orders
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Verify prior order cards are displayed
Verify order date and price information are displayed

title: Log in and add a new product
description: This verifies that an authenticated user can create a new product from the admin page and see confirmation.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Click the link to the admin page
Fill in the product name field with Demo Product Alpha
Fill in the product price field with a valid price
Fill in the product category field with Demo Category
Submit the new product form
Verify the new product appears in the admin product list
Verify a success confirmation is visible

title: Edit an existing product from admin
description: This verifies that an authenticated user can update an existing product in admin and see the updated product reflected in the list.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Click the link to the admin page
Select an existing product to edit
Update the product name field to Demo Product Beta
Update the product price field to a valid price
Save the product changes
Verify the updated product appears in the admin product list
Verify a success confirmation is visible

title: Delete an existing product from admin
description: This verifies that an authenticated user can remove a product from admin and see confirmation that the product is no longer listed.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Click the link to the admin page
Delete an existing product
Verify the removed product is no longer displayed in the admin product list
Verify a success confirmation is visible

title: Attempt a purchase from the catalog
description: This test verifies that a shopper can try buying a product from the catalog and see purchase feedback.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click a product's buy action
Verify a purchase success confirmation is visible

title: Show an error for invalid login
description: This test verifies that submitting invalid credentials keeps the user on the login page and shows an authentication error.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email field with invalid credentials
Fill in the password field with invalid credentials
Submit the login form
Verify an invalid credentials error alert is visible

title: Handle an invalid product page
description: This test verifies that visiting an invalid product id shows the invalid product state instead of a product detail view.

steps.description: Navigate to /product/999999
Verify an invalid product state is visible
